regime_context: Hong Kong shows a narrow, low-cohesion leadership structure: only 4 of 17 themes are trend-gate eligible, and the leader (Energy H-shares) has no ETF proxy and is not scorable, so the top of the board is largely ungradeable. The only two scorable themes (China Tech & Internet, China Platform Megacaps) are both at the bottom of the ranks and below the trend gate, so there is no clean, verifiable long candidate; the notable texture is crowding in Banks (a sizing caution only).
emerging_watch: Watch Banks (H + HK) for a confirmed leadership handoff from Energy: it is the only crowded theme (crowding_z=1.09, crowded=true) and the challenger to Energy with a margin of only 0.136. The condition that would retire this watch is Banks overtaking Energy in confirmed trend-gate-eligible durability (durability_bar rising above Energy's 0.76 with eligible still true) OR Banks' crowding flag persisting without a durability gain for two consecutive weekly prints.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: The theme is below the absolute-trend gate (eligible=false, durability_bar 0.23) and ranks 14/17 with negative score, so trend discipline would keep it de-risked. Given gate_helps=true on this market, the one validated edge — drawdown/shake-out avoidance — argues for not owning the weakest eligible-trend area, though this is a discipline lean rather than an alpha call.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst and deeply negative crowding_z (-0.91) could mean a bounce is near, and with no trend edge this is only a vol-control stance, not a short.

falsifier.text: China Tech & Internet ETF 3033.HK closes above its own trend gate (eligible flips true) and ranks above Hong Kong dividend sectors before the check-by date.

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: Ranks 15/17 and below trend gate (durability_bar 0.18, eligible=false), the weakest scorable theme. The only defensible read from the validated leg is to avoid holding this as a long exposure while it sits in the trend-gated-out zone.
theses.dissent: This shares the same ETF proxy (3033.HK) as the broader China Tech theme, so the two scorable themes are highly correlated — there is no independent bet here, and the underweight is essentially the same view repeated.

falsifier.text: China Platform Megacaps ETF 3033.HK flips eligible (above trend gate) and score turns positive relative to the Hang Seng before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
